description: Java source code implementing a CBOR factory using Jackson library, providing serialization and deserialization of JSON values to CBOR format, with custom parsing and object creation methods.

classes.name: JacksonCborFactory
classes.description: Implementation of CborFactory using Jackson and Jackson-CBOR for CBOR serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: isCborAvailable
methods.description: Indicates that CBOR is available, always returns true.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Reads JSON value from byte array or ByteBuffer, parsing CBOR data.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Converts JsonValue to byte array in CBOR format.

methods.name: toByteBuffer
methods.description: Converts JsonValue to ByteBuffer in CBOR format.

methods.name: writeToByteBuffer
methods.description: Writes JsonValue into provided ByteBuffer in CBOR format.

methods.name: createCborRepresentation
methods.description: Creates CBOR byte array from a map of JsonFields.

methods.name: createCborRepresentation
methods.description: Creates CBOR byte array from a list of JsonValues.
